cards.audioText: What risks will snow and ice on aircraft surfaces bring to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机表面积雪和结冰会给飞行安全带来哪些风险？
cards.referenceText: The main risks are loss of lift, higher drag, inaccurate airspeed indications, and possible control difficulty. These risks may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload, so pilots should monitor the aircraft carefully and be ready to take conservative action.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要风险包括升力损失、阻力增大、空速指示不准以及可能操纵困难。这些风险会降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷，因此飞行员应认真监控飞机状态，并准备采取保守处置。

cards.audioText: How can ice contamination on the wings affect flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 机翼结冰污染会如何影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: Ice contamination changes the wing shape and surface roughness. It can reduce lift, increase drag and stall speed, impair handling, and create unreliable instrument or control indications. Even a small amount of contamination can significantly reduce the safety margin, especially during takeoff and landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 结冰污染会改变机翼外形并增加表面粗糙度，可能降低升力、增加阻力和失速速度、恶化操纵性能，并造成仪表或操纵指示不可靠。即使少量污染也可能显著降低安全裕度，尤其是在起飞和着陆阶段。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do to ensure safety in this situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 在这种情况下，飞行员应如何确保飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: Pilots should not take off until all critical surfaces are free of prohibited contamination. They should use approved de-icing or anti-icing procedures, respect holdover-time limitations, perform the required checks, and reassess conditions if precipitation continues. If a clean-aircraft condition cannot be confirmed, the departure should be delayed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在确认所有关键表面没有禁止的污染前，飞行员不应起飞。机组应采用经批准的除冰或防冰程序，遵守保持时间限制，完成规定检查，并在降水持续时重新评估条件。如果无法确认飞机清洁，应延误离场。
